headline: CMS Energy (CMS) Exits Renewable Development, Is The Stock Still Cheap?
summary: CMS Energy (CMS) stock is reacting to a mixed update, with weaker second quarter earnings alongside a decision to exit non utility renewable development and concentrate future capital on regulated utility investments. headline: Did CMS’s Renewables Exit and Regulated Pivot Just Shift CMS Energy's (CMS) Investment Narrative?
summary: In the past week, CMS Energy Corporation reported second-quarter 2026 results showing sales of US$1,829 million and net income of US$120 million, while reaffirming full-year guidance and announcing plans to exit its non-utility renewable development business to refocus US$1.70 billion of capital on regulated utility operations.
